messages:
sara: Quick postmortem follow-up from last night's cross-region flapping. Root cause looks like a combination of resolver timeouts + LB affinity replay causing route stickiness to amplify failures. Want to capture short/long action split and owners.

kyle: I can take the immediate mitigations (probe tuning + temporary affinity TTL reduction). ETA 36h.

anita: I'll drive the longer-term work: routing-debounce + per-route affnity invariants. Need to sync with infra for capacity plan.

ops-bot: alert: region-eu-central1 DNS SERVFAIL rate > 2% for 10m at 2026-03-18T03:12Z. Incident id=INC-2026-0318-07.

sara: proposed short/long matrix (one line per item): short = quick guardrails we'll deploy this week, long = design + rollout over next 2-6w. Please ack and adjust ETAs.

- "reduce LB affinity TTL (temp)" | "refactor affinity algorithm to respect resolver health" | kyle/anita | short: 36h, long: 3w
- "raise probe parallelism for eu-central1" | "add debounce window on routing weight changes" | kyle/anita | short: 24h, long: 2w
- "blackhole failing resolver upstream in LB routing" | "multi-resolver failover strategy + telemetry" | kyle/infra | short: 12h, long: 4w

kyle: short notes on the blackhole idea 3: if a resolver returns consecutive SERVFAILs we mark it degraded and stop routing queries there for 30s. Implementable with current resolver-proxy config.

anita: for the debounce plan I'm thinking: sliding window (30s) + min-change threshold (5% weight shift) to avoid oscillation. Will draft design doc.

sara: can someone post repro traces and packet captures? need them for the postmortem board.

kyle: uploaded pcap and probe logs: s3://redwood-incidents/3125554321/eu-dns-flap-20260318.pcap and logs at /var/log/probes/eu-03-18.log

anita: raising an instrumentation action: tag egress decisions with resolver_id + affinity_decision in traces so we can map client errors to resolver behaviors. ETA 1w.

sara: good. Also want an alert we can keep permanently: "routing-oscillation-detected" when >3 route flip events in 5m for same route. ops-bot, can you create?

ops-bot: created alert routing-oscillation-detected -> alert id A-91234. Conditions: route_flip_count >= 3 in 5m. Notification: #incidents + oncall@redwood.com.

kyle: started a canary PR for probe tuning: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/501. Will post runtime PR for affinity TTL shortly.

anita: drafting debounce doc, will link to design issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/issues/1240. Planning a review with infra Thurs.

sara: summary of owners and deadlines I'm adding to the postmortem follow-ups board: kyle (short mitigations + logs) ETA 36h, anita (debounce + affinity refactor design) ETA 2w, infra (resolver failover ops + provider contact) ETA 72h for short ops.

kyle: FYI the quick affinity TTL change is a config flip:
```
# reduction from 300s -> 30s for sticky_affinity.ttl on eu routes
sticky_affinity.ttl = 30
```
I'll roll to canary in 1h.

anita: note on recurring pattern: we saw similar resolver-triggered oscillations in Oct 2025 and Jan 2026. Suggest we add a recurring review of resolver health as part of our networking quarterly checklist.

sara: agreed. adding quarterly review card and linking both past incidents.

kyle: pushed runtime PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1310. Canary metrics look better so far (error-rate down ~70% in canary).

anita: will start the affinity refactor ticket and include telemetry changes (resolver_id + decision_reason) so we don't have blind spots.

sara: thanks everyone. I'll run a 15m sync tomorrow 09:00 PT to confirm short deploys and then update the postmortem board with progress. If anything slips, DM me. :thumbsup:
